description: Batch-global multiclass Lovasz-Softmax Jaccard surrogate using softmax errors, descending sorting, and cumulative Jaccard-loss increments; follows Berman et al. §2.2 Eqs. (11)–(13), §3 Algorithm 1, and §3.1 for present-class averaging (.autopilot/sources/paper.txt:286-318,340-388,418-420). The optional valid-pixel mask follows the segmentation recipe hook (src/topologies/training/recipes/segmentation.py:41-45).

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    image = torch.rand((1, 8, 8), generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    mask = torch.zeros((8, 8), dtype=torch.long)
    mask[2:6, 2:6] = 1
    return {"pixels": synth.Tensor(image), "mask": synth.Tensor(mask)}
ds = synth.Spec("lovasz-softmax-segmentation", generator=samples, size=8, splits={"train": 0.75, "val": 0.25}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("segmentation", split="train")
val = ds.for_recipe("segmentation", split="val", like=train)
model = build("unet", "tiny", in_channels=1, out_channels=2, features=[4, 8])
trainer = Trainer(model, train, val, recipe="segmentation", recipe_config={"loss": "lovasz-softmax", "loss_kwargs": {"classes": "present"}}, max_epochs=1, batch_size=2, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
result = trainer.evaluate(val)
examples.title: Train a segmenter with Lovasz-Softmax

name: Lovasz-Softmax loss

parameters.classes: 'all' averages every class (default); 'present' averages classes appearing in valid targets
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because ignored pixels are unsupported
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point raw class logits shaped [N, C, *S] with C >= 1 and nonempty dimensions
parameters.mask: optional boolean valid-pixel mask shaped like targets; supplied by the segmentation recipe
parameters.reduction: 'none' returns one value per selected class; 'mean' averages selected classes (default); 'sum' totals them
parameters.targets: integer class indices shaped [N, *S] with values in [0, C)
